name: Lelapa AI Vulavula
description: African-language speech and translation API with a free tier.
overview: Lelapa's Vulavula API covers speech-to-text, translation and language identification for African languages, with a free tier for developers. Client data is not used for model training, but audio and transcript retention is governed by a DPA whose TTL is not public.
notes: Retention TTL is set by the DPA and is not public.
